correctness.rationale: The two fractional-power corrections each equal an integral of positive rank-one resolvent Gramians with weight t^s or t^(-s). Sherman–Morrison fixes the strictly positive denominator. A kernel vector has zero quadratic form iff its resolvent scalar is identically zero; independence of poles at distinct active eigenvalues forces orthogonality to each active spectral projection. Spectral interpolation identifies the corresponding range with the Krylov space. Exact 2x2 square-root determinant 5-18/sqrt(13)>0 provides a symbolic strictness certificate. A standalone script passed 279 deterministic checks, but universal validity rests on the analytic proof.

A general theorem for strictly operator-monotone functions with infinite-support Stieltjes measures, if published, could imply the result; that residual risk is disclosed rather than dismissed.

evidence: Shmueli et al. establish decay bounds for the correction singular values; these do not supply a positive lower bound for all nonzero eigenvalues or rank equality on inactive/repeated eigenspaces.

Beckermann et al. (2018, 2021) establish convergent polynomial/rational Krylov approximations and rank ceilings for rational functions; neither entails strict positivity of the full fractional correction on every active spectral mode.
The scalar/identity special case in Higham Theorem 1.35 as discussed in Shmueli §1.1 has exactly one active eigenspace and rank-one correction, which is a special case of the proposed classification.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The claim is equivalent to strict positivity of the Gramian restricted to the A-cyclic subspace of u. A generic statement that a square-root update tends to be full rank is weaker: it supplies neither an if-and-only-if for repeated/inactive eigenvalues nor a common kernel for every 0<s<1 and its negative-power counterpart. The full Krylov-space containment available from exact projection does not imply positive definiteness on that space.

originality.rationale: Compared exact statement and implications with directly related published low-rank matrix-square-root and general matrix-function-update papers, their key proof/eigenvalue-decay theorems, rational Krylov coverage, indexed mathematical records, and accessible earlier research claims. The source proves geometrically fast approximate low-rank correction and mentions generic full rank; the distinct active-eigenvalue rank formula for both fractional-power signs and equality of their exact ranges is not stated in the inspected sources. Generic operator-monotone or Loewner matrix strictness remains an identified publication-priority risk.

value.rationale: An exact, complete structural rank/range/kernel classification is a motivated missing invariant for low-rank-updated covariance and whitening matrix functions. It specifies when exact low rank is impossible despite excellent approximate low-rank performance, handles all repeated/inactive spectral configurations and all fractional exponents, and exhibits a sharp rank-one to full-rank phenomenon on a fully exact 2x2 example. The result is structural, not an unsupported accuracy or complexity improvement.
